# mergegateway_credential (Resource)

Manages a bring-your-own-key (BYOK) credential: the organization's own key for a vendor, which the Gateway uses instead of Merge-managed access. An organization has at most one credential per vendor, and BYOK needs a Pro or Enterprise plan. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later: the secrets are write-only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Ephemeral variables (Terraform 1.10+) also keep the secrets out of saved plan files.
variable "azure_openai_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

variable "vertex_service_account_json" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

# The organization's own Azure OpenAI key, used instead of Merge-managed access.
resource "mergegateway_credential" "azure" {
  vendor = "azure"
  name   = "Azure OpenAI production"

  # Write-only (Terraform 1.11+): never stored in the plan or state. Terraform
  # sends the key on create, and again only when the version changes: to rotate
  # it, set the new key and bump the version, such as to 2.
  api_key_wo         = var.azure_openai_api_key
  api_key_wo_version = 1

  api_base = "https://example.openai.azure.com"
  config = {
    api_version      = "2024-02-15-preview"
    azure_deployment = "gpt-4o"
  }
}

# Vertex AI authenticates with a service account instead of an API key.
resource "mergegateway_credential" "vertex" {
  vendor                          = "vertexai"
  fallback_to_managed             = false
  service_account_json_wo         = var.vertex_service_account_json
  service_account_json_wo_version = 1
  config = {
    vertex_project  = "my-gcp-project"
    vertex_location = "us-central1"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `vendor` (String) The vendor's slug, such as `openai`; see the `mergegateway_vendors` data source for those that allow BYOK. It can't be changed after creation: changing it replaces the credential.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_base` (String) A custom base URL for the vendor's API. Removing it keeps the current value: the API can't clear it, so Terraform stops managing it.
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The vendor API key. Required to create a credential, except for `vertexai` (which uses `service_account_json_wo`) and `bedrock` (which can use AWS keys or a role instead). `credential_hint` shows the stored key's last 4 characters. Write-only (Terraform 1.11+): Terraform sends it to the API but never stores it in the plan or state. It is sent on create, and on update only when `api_key_wo_version` changes: to rotate it, set the new value and change the version. The API never returns it, so a change made outside Terraform isn't detected. Removing it keeps the stored value.
- `api_key_wo_version` (Number) Set with `api_key_wo`. Change it, to any other number, to send `api_key_wo` again, such as to rotate it.
- `aws_secret_access_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Bedrock secret access key, set with `config.aws_access_key_id`. Write-only (Terraform 1.11+): Terraform sends it to the API but never stores it in the plan or state. It is sent on create, and on update only when `aws_secret_access_key_wo_version` changes: to rotate it, set the new value and change the version. The API never returns it, so a change made outside Terraform isn't detected. Removing it keeps the stored value.
- `aws_secret_access_key_wo_version` (Number) Set with `aws_secret_access_key_wo`. Change it, to any other number, to send `aws_secret_access_key_wo` again, such as to rotate it.
- `config` (Attributes) Vendor-specific settings. Each applies only to the vendors it names. Removing the block keeps every current setting. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--config))
- `fallback_to_managed` (Boolean) When a request with this key fails, retry it once on Merge-managed access for the same vendor, if the organization has it. Defaults to `true`.
- `name` (String) The credential's name. Leave it out for none. Removing it keeps the current value: the API can't clear it, so Terraform stops managing it.
- `service_account_json_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Vertex AI service account key file, as a JSON string. Required to create a `vertexai` credential. Write-only (Terraform 1.11+): Terraform sends it to the API but never stores it in the plan or state. It is sent on create, and on update only when `service_account_json_wo_version` changes: to rotate it, set the new value and change the version. The API never returns it, so a change made outside Terraform isn't detected. Removing it keeps the stored value.
- `service_account_json_wo_version` (Number) Set with `service_account_json_wo`. Change it, to any other number, to send `service_account_json_wo` again, such as to rotate it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the credential was created (RFC 3339).
- `credential_hint` (String) The last 4 characters of the stored API key, to tell keys apart. Null when there is no API key or it is shorter than 12 characters.
- `id` (String) The credential's ID.
- `updated_at` (String) When the credential was last changed (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `config`

Optional:

- `api_version` (String) Azure OpenAI API version. Removing it keeps the current value: the API can't clear it, so Terraform stops managing it.
- `aws_access_key_id` (String) Bedrock access key ID, set with `aws_secret_access_key_wo`. Removing it keeps the current value: the API can't clear it, so Terraform stops managing it.
- `aws_region` (String) Bedrock region, such as `us-east-1`. Required to create a `bedrock` credential. Removing it keeps the current value: the API can't clear it, so Terraform stops managing it.
- `aws_role_arn` (String) Bedrock IAM role to assume, such as `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gateway`. Removing it keeps the current value: the API can't clear it, so Terraform stops managing it.
- `azure_deployment` (String) Azure OpenAI deployment name. Removing it keeps the current value: the API can't clear it, so Terraform stops managing it.
- `vertex_location` (String) Vertex AI location. Required to create a `vertexai` credential. Removing it keeps the current value: the API can't clear it, so Terraform stops managing it.
- `vertex_project` (String) Vertex AI project ID. Required to create a `vertexai` credential. Removing it keeps the current value: the API can't clear it, so Terraform stops managing it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a credential by its ID. The API never returns the secrets, so after an
# import set the one the vendor uses (api_key_wo, aws_secret_access_key_wo or
# service_account_json_wo) and its _wo_version in the configuration: the first
# apply sends it again.
terraform import mergegateway_credential.azure 2f9c3a7e-5b1d-4c8e-9f60-1a2b3c4d5e6f
```
